why: Image 1 reads as a room at night lit by its own light: downlights graze the slatted wood alcove, there are table lamps, and the seating gives the place scale and a purpose, although the blown-out lamp discs and the blocky, untextured armchair and ottoman give away that it is CG. Image 2 has the more convincing wood and a cleaner speaker, but it is an empty corner with a flat black floor, no visible light source and an awkwardly cropped second speaker, so it reads as a product render, not a photograph of a listening bar.
